meta.title: Cancel a competition
meta.description: Cancel a competition: every paid fee goes back and everyone taking part is told.

competitionCancel.title: Cancel {name}
competitionCancel.lead: Cancelling is final. Every paid fee goes back without anyone approving it, unpaid and free registrations are cancelled, and everyone taking part is told.

denied.title: Only a super admin can cancel a competition
denied.body: Cancelling refunds every paid fee with nobody else approving it, so only super admins may. Ask one if this competition must be called off.

notFound.title: There is no such competition
notFound.body: It may have been mistyped. Open it from the competitions list.

effects.told: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody is registered yet, so no family is told} one {# registration's family contact is told by email} other {# registrations' family contacts are told by email}}.
effects.institutions: {count, plural, =0 {No institution is registered} one {# institution's coordinators are told} other {# institutions' coordinators are told}}.
effects.cancelled: {count, plural, =0 {No registration is cancelled at once} one {# unpaid or free registration is cancelled at once} other {# unpaid or free registrations are cancelled at once}}; paid ones are refunded.
effects.gateway: {count, plural, =0 {No payment goes back through the gateway} one {# payment goes back through the gateway} other {# payments go back through the gateway}}.
effects.manual: {count, plural, =0 {No payment was made offline} one {# payment made offline is paid back by hand, once finance records it} other {# payments made offline are paid back by hand, once finance records each}}.
effects.dashboard: {count, plural, one {Finance refunds # payment through the gateway dashboard in its original currency} other {Finance refunds # payments through the gateway dashboard in their original currencies}}.
effects.amountDashboard: {amount} is refunded through the gateway dashboard.

form.title: Cancel it
form.lead: You will be asked for your second factor if you haven't used it in the last 10 minutes.

reason.label: Why is it cancelled?
reason.hint: Families and coordinators read this in their email. Up to {max} characters.

errors.reason_invalid: Enter the cancellation reason as text.
errors.reason_required: Write why the competition is cancelled.
errors.reason_too_long: Keep the reason to {max} characters or fewer.

alerts.already_cancelled: This competition was cancelled already. The page now shows when and why.
alerts.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was cancelled. Please try again in a few minutes.
alerts.results_published: This competition cannot be cancelled after publication of results.

cancelled.title: This competition is cancelled
cancelled.next: Gateway refunds go out automatically. Finance handles offline refunds on the refunds page and foreign-currency refunds from payment review.
cancelled.done: Cancelled. Its refunds are on their way and everyone taking part is being told.

fee.gateway: The fee paid for this registration goes back to the card, UPI or bank account it was paid from. Whoever paid it gets an email when it is refunded.
fee.manual: The fee for this registration was paid by cheque, bank transfer or cash, so we pay it back by hand. Whoever paid it gets an email when that is done.
fee.dashboard: Finance refunds the fee through the payment gateway in the original currency. Whoever paid it gets an email when it is refunded.
fee.none: Nothing was paid for this registration, so there is nothing to refund.

competitionCancel.publishedRefusal: This competition cannot be cancelled because results have been published.
